verdict.rationale: Anytype publishes a downloadable OpenAPI document at developers.anytype.io/openapi-v2.yaml with full component schemas and documented error responses. It is synced from the anytype-heart core and backed by a versioned API reference with a changelog. The probe 404s were on doc.anytype.io, a different domain from the developer portal, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec downloads and validates, explicit evidence of a downloadable spec for the stable v1 API (the v2 file belongs to a pre-release API), and no discoverable well-known spec path.
